title: Agent-Native 3D Scene Studio — A Little World, Built Together
status: The 161-second film is exported with actual native continuity capture, eight Lily narration tracks and 31 aligned subtitles. Continuity validation, representative frame review and full media decoding pass; creator playback approval and publication remain pending.
capture_note: Keep one scene and one page from the first human placement to the closing shot. Show actual native WebMCP requests and results. Label cuts that remove agent waiting time. No reset, import, preset composition or replacement take may stand in for this scene's continuity.

segments.title: I choose the starting point
segments.narration: I start with a pond, right here. A little world I can build in together with my browser agent.
segments.tts_narration: I start with a pond, right here. A little world I can build in together with my browser agent.

segments.title: The agent reads my scene
segments.narration: I place a cabin beside the water. Now I ask the agent to read what I made. WebMCP gives it the objects, their positions, and my edits.
segments.tts_narration: I place a cabin beside the water. Now I ask the agent to read what I made. Web M C P gives it the objects, their positions, and my edits.

segments.title: Build around my choices
segments.narration: Add thirty pines around my pond and cabin. Keep the water and the entrance clear. The agent builds around my choices, keeping both exactly where I placed them.
segments.tts_narration: Add thirty pines around my pond and cabin. Keep the water and the entrance clear. The agent builds around my choices, keeping both exactly where I placed them.
segments.visual: Show the natural-language request and actual native scatter call. Keep the real tree reveal at original speed. Read back the added count and both unchanged anchor poses.

segments.title: Make it feel lived in
segments.narration: A few stones shape the shoreline. Warm lanterns lead back to the cabin. Every object stays selectable and editable as the little world grows.
segments.tts_narration: A few stones shape the shoreline. Warm lanterns lead back to the cabin. Every object stays selectable and editable as the little world grows.
segments.visual: Record native additions of shoreline rocks and lanterns around the existing world. Show the actual results and a query of the decorated scene, including tree ownership.

segments.title: I keep the mouse
segments.narration: This tree feels too close. I move it myself. My edit becomes part of the shared state the agent sees.
segments.tts_narration: This tree feels too close. I move it myself. My edit becomes part of the shared state the agent sees.
segments.visual: Drag a visible agent-created tree to a distinct new position. Keep the selection and human activity entry visible; capture the real pointer movement.

segments.title: Read what changed
segments.narration: I ask it to read the scene again and keep my new placement. It can see which tree moved, where it is now, and who made that change.
segments.tts_narration: I ask it to read the scene again and keep my new placement. It can see which tree moved, where it is now, and who made that change.
segments.visual: Record fresh native describe_scene and query_scene calls. Show the same tree ID, changed position, human edit and revision. Pond and cabin remain unchanged.

segments.title: Give our world an atmosphere
segments.narration: The light settles into moonlit blue, the lanterns glow, and the camera begins a slow, endless journey. My own lofi music gives everything room to breathe.
segments.tts_narration: The light settles into moonlit blue, the lanterns glow, and the camera begins a slow, endless journey. My own lofi music gives everything room to breathe.
